User.title: User
User.description: Registered Linzo Party Live user profile stored in Firestore

profileImage.description: URL or avatar path for user profile picture

coverImage.description: URL for user cover banner picture

authProvider.description: Initial authentication method used (google or password)

providerIds.description: Linked Firebase Auth provider IDs for this single UID (e.g. google.com, password)

passwordRegistered.description: Whether Email & Password authentication is linked to this Firebase UID

passwordLinkedAt.description: ISO timestamp when Email & Password credential was linked to this account

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp string when user account was created

lastLogin.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp string of last login

isOnline.description: Whether the user is currently online

level.description: User's gamified streaming level (0 to 100, 101 total levels)

totalQualifyingCoinsSpent.description: Cumulative qualifying coins spent toward 100-level progression (up to 2,000,000,000)

superVipLevel.description: Unlocked Super VIP tier level (0 to 6)

equippedVipFrame.description: Active VIP avatar frame tier (0 to 12)

equippedSuperVipFrame.description: Active Super VIP avatar frame tier (0 to 6)

activeFrameType.description: Mutually exclusive active avatar frame mode

equippedBadges.description: Up to 3 equipped independent achievement badge IDs

isVIP.description: Whether user has unlocked VIP status (Lv 8+)

isSuperVIP.description: Whether user has unlocked Super VIP status (Lv 12+)

isVerified.description: Whether the user holds a verified badge

verificationTier.description: Verification tick tier: blue (Respect) or gold (Legends)

verifiedTag.description: Optional custom verified tag label displayed next to name

isBlocked.description: Whether the account is permanently blocked by Administration

blockReason.description: Admin reason for blocking the user

suspendedUntil.description: Epoch ms when temporary suspension expires (0 = permanent until unsuspended)

suspendReason.description: Admin reason for suspending the user

isDeviceBanned.description: Whether the user's device is banned by Administration

lastDeviceId.description: Last seen persistent device identifier for device-ban enforcement

Post.title: Post
Post.description: User video post in the video feed

videoUrl.description: Cloud Storage or CDN URL of the video

thumbnailUrl.description: Cloud Storage URL of the video thumbnail

description.description: Caption or text description of the post

musicTitle.description: Audio track or music name used in the video

isPrivate.description: Whether the video is private to creator

maxSeats.description: Total stage seats capacity gated by Host level: 5 at Lv.0-9 (all 5 seats including Seat #2 unlocked at Lv.0), 8 at Lv.10+, 16 at Lv.20+

allowJoin.description: Whether listeners can request stage seats

seatTheme.description: Party room sofa seat color theme chosen by host

chatClearedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds timestamp when host or moderator last cleared the room chat history

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Wallet coin recharge or gift transaction

userId.description: UID of the user who performed transaction

amount.description: Real currency amount or coin value

UserEarnings.title: UserEarnings
UserEarnings.description: User net earnings from received virtual gifts

WithdrawalRequest.title: WithdrawalRequest
WithdrawalRequest.description: Payout request submitted by a creator

SuperVipFrame.title: SuperVipFrame
SuperVipFrame.description: Super VIP frame tier definition (6 tiers every 12 levels: 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 72)

AchievementDefinition.title: AchievementDefinition
AchievementDefinition.description: Independent achievement badge definition and unlock condition

ProgressionAuditLog.title: ProgressionAuditLog
ProgressionAuditLog.description: Immutable admin audit log entry for progression config and manual user adjustments

WalletSettings.title: WalletSettings
WalletSettings.description: Global platform commission, exchange rate, and withdrawal limit configuration

CoinSellerAgency.title: CoinSellerAgency
CoinSellerAgency.description: Official verified offline Coin Seller Agency directory entry managed by platform Admin

CommissionTransaction.title: CommissionTransaction
CommissionTransaction.description: Platform commission audit record created on gift transfers

LiveViewer.title: LiveViewer
LiveViewer.description: Active viewer inside a live stream session

RoomParticipant.title: RoomParticipant
RoomParticipant.description: Active participant in an audio party room

RankingConfig.title: RankingConfig
RankingConfig.description: Configurable weights for the TOP 1 & TOP 2 broadcaster ranking engine

StoreCategory.title: StoreCategory
StoreCategory.description: Official Lenzo Party Store categories (VIP FRAMES, SPECIAL ENTRY, CUSTOM GIFT, PREMIUM ASSETS)

StoreProduct.title: StoreProduct
StoreProduct.description: Lenzo Party Store product managed by Admin and synced live to the Store screen

UserInventoryItem.title: UserInventoryItem
UserInventoryItem.description: Purchased Store item owned by a user with equip state

CoinTransaction.title: CoinTransaction
CoinTransaction.description: Immutable Lenzo Party Store coin purchase audit transaction

BlockedUser.title: BlockedUser
BlockedUser.description: User blocking relationship preventing interactions on streams, party rooms, and direct messages

RoomKick.title: RoomKick
RoomKick.description: Host-issued party room kick preventing re-entry and interaction for current stream session, 24h, 15d, or 30d

HostModerator.title: HostModerator
HostModerator.description: Lifetime room moderator assigned by a Host across all current and future party rooms/broadcasts until removed

Reel.title: Reel
Reel.description: Short-form vertical video (max 100 MB) stored in persistent media storage or Firebase Storage and indexed in Firestore

fileSizeBytes.description: Uploaded video size in bytes (max 104857600 / 100 MB)

ReelLike.title: ReelLike
ReelLike.description: Deduplicated like edge keyed by reelId_userId

ReelComment.title: ReelComment
ReelComment.description: Persisted user comment on a reel

ReelView.title: ReelView
ReelView.description: Deduplicated reel view record keyed by reelId_userId

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Private user app preferences synced across Web and Android

ContentReport.title: ContentReport
ContentReport.description: Moderation report submitted for a reel, user, room, or stream

AccountDeletionRequest.title: AccountDeletionRequest
AccountDeletionRequest.description: Audit log for user-initiated permanent account deletion requests

AgencyApplication.title: AgencyApplication
AgencyApplication.description: KYC application submitted by a user to become a Coin Seller Agency or Host Agency (PII restricted to applicant & admin)

DualAgency.title: DualAgency
DualAgency.description: Approved Coin Seller Agency (cs_{ownerUid}) or Host Agency (ha_{ownerUid}) public directory profile and balance metadata (no CNIC or PIN)

AgencySecretPin.title: AgencySecretPin
AgencySecretPin.description: Owner-only hashed 4-5 digit personal transfer PIN vault for Coin Seller Agency

AgencyCoinTransfer.title: AgencyCoinTransfer
AgencyCoinTransfer.description: Immutable audit record of a Coin Seller Agency coin transfer to a user

AgencyHostRequest.title: AgencyHostRequest
AgencyHostRequest.description: Host join request and negotiated contract/deal terms (commission %, target coins, monthly hours) with a Host Agency

AgencyCoinOrder.title: AgencyCoinOrder
AgencyCoinOrder.description: Buyer coin purchase order & payment slip submitted to an active Coin Seller Agency (private to buyer, agency owner, and admin)

BannedDevice.title: BannedDevice
BannedDevice.description: Device permanently banned by Lenzo Party Administration

PlatformFinancialSettings.title: PlatformFinancialSettings
PlatformFinancialSettings.description: Authoritative Lenzo Party economy configuration (Coin Purchase Rate, 40/60 Gift Split, Diamond Withdrawal Rate, Agency Commission, Fees)

PlatformRevenue.title: PlatformRevenue
PlatformRevenue.description: App Beans / Revenue Wallet aggregate totals (strictly separate from User Coins and Host Diamonds)

PlatformBeansLedger.title: PlatformBeansLedger
PlatformBeansLedger.description: Immutable App Beans revenue ledger entry created for every 40% gifting revenue split

GiftTransaction.title: GiftTransaction
GiftTransaction.description: Idempotent immutable record of a live/party/PK/private gift transaction with 40% App Beans and 60% Host Diamonds split

CoinPurchase.title: CoinPurchase
CoinPurchase.description: Verified Coin package purchase separating paid coins and promotional bonus coins

AgencyCommission.title: AgencyCommission
AgencyCommission.description: Agency commission accounting record tied to verified host diamond withdrawals

AgencyFinancialRecord.title: AgencyFinancialRecord
AgencyFinancialRecord.description: Aggregated financial performance & commission summary per Host Agency

FinancialAuditLog.title: FinancialAuditLog
FinancialAuditLog.description: Immutable financial audit log recording every economy setting change, package edit, withdrawal update, and reconciliation

UserNotification.title: UserNotification
UserNotification.description: Universal per-user real-time push notification record across messages, gifts, followers, live rooms, PK, wallet, agency, progression, and system alerts

PushSubscription.title: PushSubscription
PushSubscription.description: Per-user registered Web Push VAPID or native Android device notification endpoint

PushAnnouncement.title: PushAnnouncement
PushAnnouncement.description: Global admin push broadcast announcement delivered to all users in real time
